name: Hualan Biological Bacterin Inc.
summary: Hualan Biological Bacterin Inc. is a Chinese pharmaceutical company focused on the entire vaccine lifecycle, from research and development to manufacturing and sales within China. The company's product line features a diverse range of immunizations, including various influenza virus vaccines (such as split, quadrivalent, and H1N1 strains), recombinant hepatitis B vaccines, and meningococcal polysaccharide vaccines (including ACYW135 and Group A & C types). They also develop genetically engineered vaccines for human use. Established in 2005, Hualan Biological Bacterin Inc. is headquartered in Xinxiang, China, and previously operated as a subsidiary of Hualan Biological Engineering Inc.
